Troubleshooting · 07/50 · scheduling

Schedule dependency collision

Failure signal

A schedule dependency collision condition is reported or detected during scheduling.

Likely cause

The controlling record, technical state or approved specification for scheduling does not match the current asset or workflow.

Verification

Trace prerequisites for every task sharing crew, stage, equipment or source media.

Corrective action

Resequence the critical path and publish one authoritative schedule revision.

Prevention

Add this verification to the scheduling gate, retain immutable evidence and assign one accountable owner.
